name: Grafana Cloud
tagline: Query metrics, logs, traces, and dashboards in your Grafana Cloud stack.
description: Grafana Cloud's hosted MCP server lets agents search and edit dashboards, run Prometheus, Loki, Tempo, and Pyroscope queries, and work with alerts, incidents, and OnCall as the signed-in user. The open source mcp-grafana server also works with Cloud stacks, and with self-managed Grafana, using a service account token.

methods.label: OAuth 2.1
methods.note: The hosted Cloud MCP server signs in the Grafana user in the browser. Clients with dynamic client registration connect without setup.

methods.label: Service account token
methods.note: The self-managed mcp-grafana server and the Grafana HTTP API use a service account token.

auth.guide:
**Cloud MCP with OAuth (fastest):** add the hosted server and approve access in the browser. Set `X-Grafana-URL` to your stack to skip the stack prompt.

```bash
claude mcp add grafana https://mcp.grafana.com/mcp \
  --transport http \
  --header "X-Grafana-URL: https://$GRAFANA_STACK.grafana.net"
```

The consent screen offers **Read**, **Query**, and **Write**. Query runs raw SQL as written against sources such as ClickHouse or Snowflake, so clear both Query and Write for read-only agents. You need the **Assistant Cloud MCP User** role (Editor and above have it). Tokens refresh for 30 days, then you sign in again. Each MCP user counts as an active user for billing.

**Several stacks:** add one entry per stack with the stack in the path, for example `https://mcp.grafana.com/mcp/$GRAFANA_STACK.grafana.net`. Claude Code and Cursor treat entries that share a URL as duplicates.

**Clients without dynamic registration:** register a client under **Assistant > Settings > Connectors > MCP clients** (auth code + S256 PKCE; the secret is shown once).

**Self-managed Grafana:** run the OSS server with a service account token.

```bash
claude mcp add grafana-oss -e GRAFANA_URL=$GRAFANA_URL -e GRAFANA_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN=$GRAFANA_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN -- uvx mcp-grafana
```

interfaces.name: Grafana Cloud MCP
interfaces.note: Streamable HTTP only (no SSE). OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration and S256 PKCE; scopes grafana:read, grafana:query, grafana:write. Pick the stack with the X-Grafana-URL header or https://mcp.grafana.com/mcp/<stack>.grafana.net. Grafana Cloud only.

interfaces.name: Grafana MCP (self-managed)
interfaces.description: Open source MCP server for self-managed Grafana and Grafana Cloud, run locally with uvx and a service account token.
interfaces.note: Set GRAFANA_URL to the instance URL and GRAFANA_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN to a service account token. Source: https://github.com/grafana/mcp-grafana
